simple.meaning: צַח (tsach) is a Hebrew word meaning “dazzling , i.e. sunny , bright , (figuratively) evident.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צַח (H6703) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 5:10, with occurrences in Song of Solomon, Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צַח (H6703) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צַח (H6703) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צַח (tsach) / H6703 is traced through Song of Songs 5:10, Isaiah 18:4, Isaiah 32:4, Jeremiah 4:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6703. tsach צַח adjective dazzling, glowing, clear ; — צַח חֹם Isa 18:4 glowing heat ; צַח רוּחַ Jer 4:11 glowing wind ; וְאָדוֺם צַח דּוֺדִי Song 5:10 my beloved is dazzling (white) and ruddy (compare Lam 4:7 ); feminine plural צַחוֺת לְדַבֵּר Isa 32:4 to speak clear (words), clearly .
